z: 囪 imigudu, umgudu, umgudu wesibindi, isibindi, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
A child does not need a conversation performed. A child needs a person who can be found. Being findable is the practice. The words can come later, or not.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. What you are seeing is imigudu, umgudu, umgudu wesibindi, isibindi, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 囪 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Put the glowing thing in another room. Sit where you can be seen. You do not have to perform a talk.

z: 囫 imigudu, umgudu, umgudu wesibindi, isibindi, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
Forgiveness does not require the betrayed to be foolish. It requires them to decide whether the person is still a member. Membership is a practice after it has been a wound.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. What you are seeing is imigudu, umgudu, umgudu wesibindi, isibindi, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 囫 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Name the break once, without extra charges. Then do one small trustworthy thing, and repeat it tomorrow.

z: 囬 imigudu, umgudu, umgudu wesibindi, isibindi, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
A marriage that has lost a child, or a parent, or a future, needs presence more than explanation. Explanation is a way of leaving. Sitting is a way of staying.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. What you are seeing is imigudu, umgudu, umgudu wesibindi, isibindi, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 囬 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Do not hurry a grieving person into cheer. Let the absent name be said.

z: 园 imigudu, umgudu, umgudu wesibindi, isibindi, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
A marriage in despair does not need a speech about gratitude. It needs one true plan for tomorrow that both people can bear. Make the plan small enough to be kept.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. What you are seeing is imigudu, umgudu, umgudu wesibindi, isibindi, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 园 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Make one plan for tomorrow small enough that both of you can keep it.

z: 囯 imigudu, umgudu, umgudu wesibindi, isibindi, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
In a marriage, revenge is often petty and therefore easy to excuse. The small cut, repeated, is how love is replaced by a contest. Mercy is leaving one cut unanswered.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. What you are seeing is imigudu, umgudu, umgudu wesibindi, isibindi, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 囯 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Leave one cut unanswered today. Do not announce the leaving.

z: 囱 imigudu, umgudu, umgudu wesibindi, isibindi, phezulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
Accountability begins when you can say, the heat was mine. Wisdom begins when you can say, it had a better door. Compassion begins when the person you nearly burned is still in the room, and you stay.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. What you are seeing is imigudu, umgudu, umgudu wesibindi, isibindi, phezulu, ngakwesokudla, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 囱 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Before the second loud sentence, step into the doorway, not toward the person. Let the heat guard the house from outside.

z: 围 imigudu, umgudu, umgudu wesibindi, isibindi, phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Self-reflection is the moment you notice you needed to win. Accountability is saying so before you are forced. The turn from pride to dignity is mostly this small honesty.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. What you are seeing is imigudu, umgudu, umgudu wesibindi, isibindi, phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 围 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Admit one small wrong without a speech about your intentions. Stop when the admission is complete.

z: 囵 imigudu, umgudu, umgudu wesibindi, isibindi, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Siblings are assigned the same story and different gifts. Envy calls this injustice. Admiration calls it a house with more than one lamp. Both lamps belong on the table.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. What you are seeing is imigudu, umgudu, umgudu wesibindi, isibindi, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 囵 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Clap, or thank, before you comment. Let the first sound from you be glad.

z: 囸 imigudu, umgudu, umgudu wesibindi, isibindi, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Many houses, under many names, give the same command: do not be ruled by dread, and do not despise the person who is. The strong are asked to stay, not to sneer.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. What you are seeing is imigudu, umgudu, umgudu wesibindi, isibindi, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 囸 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Tell the truth you have been saving, and remain in the room after it is told.

z: 囻 imigudu, umgudu, umgudu wesibindi, isibindi, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla
line:
Hospitality is the oldest sociology of the lasting house. The stranger eats first. The family that cannot do this for a guest will eventually fail to do it for itself.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. What you are seeing is imigudu, umgudu, umgudu wesibindi, isibindi, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 囻 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Put one thing you were keeping back into the middle of the table.

z: 囼 imigudu, umgudu, umgudu wesibindi, isibindi, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Siblings remember the name they were called on the worst day. Do not give them that name. Give them the name of the good you have actually seen them do.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. What you are seeing is imigudu, umgudu, umgudu wesibindi, isibindi, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 囼 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Say the hard thing to the face, once, cleanly, with no audience.

z: 图 imigudu, umgudu, umgudu wesibindi, isibindi, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Children who are met with contempt learn to hide the clumsy part, which is most of them. Appreciation gives that part a chair.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. What you are seeing is imigudu, umgudu, umgudu wesibindi, isibindi, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 图 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Remove the sneer from a sentence and speak it again. Notice how much of it was only the sneer.

z: 圁 imigudu, umgudu, umgudu wesibindi, isibindi, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
The old practice of sitting with the sick, of keeping watch, of not filling the air, is this turn. Do not rush to be useful. Be there.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. What you are seeing is imigudu, umgudu, umgudu wesibindi, isibindi, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 圁 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Sit with a person who is not ready to speak. Let ten minutes pass without fixing them.

z: 圂 imigudu, umgudu, umgudu wesibindi, isibindi, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
The wisdom shared by many houses is hard: do not let the sun go down on a break you are willing to heal, and do not call it healing if you are only waiting to retell it.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. What you are seeing is imigudu, umgudu, umgudu wesibindi, isibindi, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 圂 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Eat together once without retelling the wound. Let the meal be only a meal.

z: 圅 imigudu, umgudu, umgudu wesibindi, isibindi, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Children grieve in strange hours and then ask for ordinary things. Both are grief. Answer the ordinary thing. Do not make them perform a sadness you can recognize.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. What you are seeing is imigudu, umgudu, umgudu wesibindi, isibindi, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 圅 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Answer the ordinary request of a grieving child. Do not make them perform a sadness you recognize.

z: 圆 imigudu, umgudu, umgudu wesibindi, isibindi, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
A child who sees an adult look again, after a bad day, learns that a bad day is not a verdict. This is worth more than any optimism you could announce.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. What you are seeing is imigudu, umgudu, umgudu wesibindi, isibindi, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 圆 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Decline the word forever. Keep the true sentence about the pain, and stop before the lie.

z: 圇 imigudu, umgudu, umgudu wesibindi, isibindi, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Children are the usual casualties of a score kept between adults. They did not agree to carry it. Mercy toward the person you resent is also protection of the child.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. What you are seeing is imigudu, umgudu, umgudu wesibindi, isibindi, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 圇 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Tell the truth of the wrong once, to the person, and then do not serve it at breakfast.

z: 圌 imigudu, umgudu, umgudu wesibindi, isibindi, maphakathi, ngakwesokudla
line:
Siblings fight because they share a roof and a hunger. The fight is not the failure. The failure is when the stronger one discovers a liking for the smaller one's fear. Protection refuses that discovery.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. What you are seeing is imigudu, umgudu, umgudu wesibindi, isibindi, maphakathi, ngakwesokudla, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 圌 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Teach the strong child to stand in front of the smaller one. That is anger, turned, and it can be learned young.

z: 圎 imigudu, umgudu, umgudu wesibindi, isibindi, maphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Brothers and sisters are the first public. What you do to be admired at home becomes the way they will treat their own children. Give them a dignity they can copy.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. What you are seeing is imigudu, umgudu, umgudu wesibindi, isibindi, maphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 圎 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Praise a person in the house for a quality you do not share. Do not add a correction.

z: 圐 imigudu, umgudu, umgudu wesibindi, isibindi, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
The teachings that endured all warn the eye. They also bless the eye that rejoices. Rejoicing is not a mood. It is a decision made again each time the other person shines.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. What you are seeing is imigudu, umgudu, umgudu wesibindi, isibindi, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 圐 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: When a sibling is praised, add one true sentence of your own. Do not balance it with your own news.

z: 圑 imigudu, umgudu, umgudu wesibindi, isibindi, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Fear of the future makes a house small. Courage does not enlarge the future. It keeps today's people inside the house while the future remains unknown.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. What you are seeing is imigudu, umgudu, umgudu wesibindi, isibindi, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 圑 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Name the person you are afraid of losing, and spend the next hour near them without a speech.

z: 圔 imigudu, umgudu, umgudu wesibindi, isibindi, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokudla
line:
Psychology is simple here. The closed hand teaches the body that the world is about to run out. The open hand teaches it that tomorrow includes other people.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. What you are seeing is imigudu, umgudu, umgudu wesibindi, isibindi, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokudla, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 圔 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Give a thing away that you still like. Do not wait until you are tired of it.

z: 圗 imigudu, umgudu, umgudu wesibindi, isibindi, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Gossip is how a house talks about its own when they have left the room. Healing speech waits until they are back, and then says the hard thing to the face, cleanly.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. What you are seeing is imigudu, umgudu, umgudu wesibindi, isibindi, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 圗 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Tell one story tonight in which a person in this house is repaired, not mocked.

z: 圙 imigudu, umgudu, umgudu wesibindi, isibindi, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Across the old writings, the warning against scoffing is constant. A scoffer cannot be taught, and a house that scoffs cannot learn itself.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. What you are seeing is imigudu, umgudu, umgudu wesibindi, isibindi, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 圙 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Ask to be shown a skill you had decided was beneath you. Watch the whole way through.

z: 圚 imigudu, umgudu, umgudu wesibindi, isibindi, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Some truths are not ready for speech. Presence holds them without using them as a weapon. A weaponized silence is still a weapon.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. What you are seeing is imigudu, umgudu, umgudu wesibindi, isibindi, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 圚 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Put the glowing thing in another room. Sit where you can be seen. You do not have to perform a talk.

z: 圛 imigudu, umgudu, umgudu wesibindi, isibindi, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla
line:
A child who watches a break become a lifelong trial learns that love is a court. A child who watches a break become a mended bowl learns that love can survive its own failure.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. What you are seeing is imigudu, umgudu, umgudu wesibindi, isibindi, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 圛 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Name the break once, without extra charges. Then do one small trustworthy thing, and repeat it tomorrow.

z: 圝 imigudu, umgudu, umgudu wesibindi, isibindi, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Compassion is grief that has recognized itself in another body and does not hurry it. Hurry is fear. The unhurried hour is the gift.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. What you are seeing is imigudu, umgudu, umgudu wesibindi, isibindi, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 圝 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Do not hurry a grieving person into cheer. Let the absent name be said.

z: 圞 imigudu, umgudu, umgudu wesibindi, isibindi, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
The sciences of a lasting household call this resilience. The older word is faithfulness. It does not deny the dark. It refuses to let the dark be the only speaker.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. What you are seeing is imigudu, umgudu, umgudu wesibindi, isibindi, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 圞 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Open the curtain before you decide what the day is. Let the house see you do it.

z: 圠 imigudu, umgudu, umgudu wesibindi, isibindi, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Many sacred traditions, in different grammars, say the same hard thing: the injury stops when someone declines to pass it on. This is not weakness. It is the end of a chain.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. What you are seeing is imigudu, umgudu, umgudu wesibindi, isibindi, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 圠 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Do one undeserved kindness where you are keeping score. Do not mention the score.

z: 圢 imigudu, umgudu, umgudu wesibindi, isibindi, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
At the table, anger wants the last word. The last word is rarely food. Let the sentence end before it becomes the story the children will tell about this house.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. What you are seeing is imigudu, umgudu, umgudu wesibindi, isibindi, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 圢 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: When the heat rises, name who you are actually keeping safe. Put your body between the danger and the child. Do not spend the heat on the child.

z: 圤 imigudu, umgudu, umgudu wesibindi, isibindi, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
The guest at the table is a test you did not schedule. If your worth requires the guest to be less clever, less beautiful, less faithful, your worth is a costume. Take it off.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. What you are seeing is imigudu, umgudu, umgudu wesibindi, isibindi, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 圤 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Once, take the lower seat on purpose. Let someone in the house finish a story you could have told better.

z: 圥 imithambo, ikhanda, intamo, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
What you wish were yours, name it exactly, in the hearing of the person who has it. Then do not reach. The naming is the confession. The not-reaching is the turn.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. What you are seeing is imithambo, ikhanda, intamo, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 圥 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Clap, or thank, before you comment. Let the first sound from you be glad.

z: 圪 imithambo, ikhanda, intamo, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Name the loss you are counting. Often it is a person in the room, not a disaster outside. Then put your body beside that person. That is the whole practice.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. What you are seeing is imithambo, ikhanda, intamo, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 圪 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Tell the truth you have been saving, and remain in the room after it is told.

z: 圫 imithambo, ikhanda, intamo, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
Give before you calculate whether you will be thanked. Thanks are not the food. If you require them, you have made a trade, and a trade is not yet a family.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. What you are seeing is imithambo, ikhanda, intamo, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 圫 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Put one thing you were keeping back into the middle of the table.

z: 圬 imithambo, ikhanda, intamo, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Wisdom is not silence forever. There is a time to speak. The test is whether the words can be repeated in front of the person, and still be a kindness.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. What you are seeing is imithambo, ikhanda, intamo, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 圬 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: If you gave someone a cruel name, retire it today, out loud, and do not use it again.

z: 圮 imithambo, ikhanda, intamo, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Look at the work you have stopped seeing. Name it. The naming is not flattery. It is the return of sight, and sight is the turn.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. What you are seeing is imithambo, ikhanda, intamo, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 圮 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Look at one ordinary object they mended or prepared, and say what it cost them.

z: 圱 imithambo, ikhanda, intamo, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Put the glowing thing in another room. Sit where you can be seen. You do not have to be interesting. You do have to be in the house.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. What you are seeing is imithambo, ikhanda, intamo, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 圱 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: If your quiet has been a punishment, break it with one gentle sentence and then stay.

z: 圲 imithambo, ikhanda, intamo, phezulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
Accountability is the first half. Without it, forgiveness is a fog. The one who broke the trust says what was done, without a speech about why it was almost justified.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. What you are seeing is imithambo, ikhanda, intamo, phezulu, ngakwesokudla, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 圲 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: If you were the one who broke trust, say what you did without a speech about why it was almost fair.

z: 圵 imithambo, ikhanda, intamo, phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
The oldest writings are full of lament, not because lament is holy by itself, but because love that cannot lament becomes hard. Let the house be soft enough to cry.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. What you are seeing is imithambo, ikhanda, intamo, phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 圵 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Answer the ordinary request of a grieving child. Do not make them perform a sadness you recognize.

z: 圶 imithambo, ikhanda, intamo, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Despair often tells the truth about pain and then adds a lie about forever. Keep the truth. Decline the forever. Forever is not a fact available to a person at a window.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. What you are seeing is imithambo, ikhanda, intamo, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 圶 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Decline the word forever. Keep the true sentence about the pain, and stop before the lie.

z: 圹 imithambo, ikhanda, intamo, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele

The guest at the table is a test you did not schedule. If your worth requires the guest to be less clever, less beautiful, less faithful, your worth is a costume. Take it off.

Name the loss you are counting. Often it is a person in the room, not a disaster outside. Then put your body beside that person. That is the whole practice.

Give before you calculate whether you will be thanked. Thanks are not the food. If you require them, you have made a trade, and a trade is not yet a family.

Look at the work you have stopped seeing. Name it. The naming is not flattery. It is the return of sight, and sight is the turn.

Put the glowing thing in another room. Sit where you can be seen. You do not have to be interesting. You do have to be in the house.

z: 奃 i-pancreas, phezulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
Accountability is the first half. Without it, forgiveness is a fog. The one who broke the trust says what was done, without a speech about why it was almost justified.

practice: Decide, and say, whether the person is still a member. Do not leave them in a fog.

z: 奅 i-pancreas, phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
The oldest writings are full of lament, not because lament is holy by itself, but because love that cannot lament becomes hard. Let the house be soft enough to cry.

practice: Leave the empty place unspoken-of only if the grieving person wishes it. Otherwise, speak the name.

z: 奊 i-pancreas, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Despair often tells the truth about pain and then adds a lie about forever. Keep the truth. Decline the forever. Forever is not a fact available to a person at a window.

practice: Set one place at the table that despair said was pointless. Eat there.

z: 奋 i-pancreas, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Accountability remains. Mercy is not the cancellation of truth. It is the decision that truth will not be used as a knife at breakfast for the next twenty years.

practice: If a child is carrying a feud that belongs to adults, take it back. Say that it is not theirs.

z: 奌 i-pancreas, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla
line:
An elder who has turned anger into protection does not become mild. The wall is still warm. What changes is the face it turns toward. It faces the street, not the cradle.

practice: Teach the strong child to stand in front of the smaller one. That is anger, turned, and it can be learned young.

line:
An elder's dignity is not the right to be obeyed in every small thing. It is the right to be respected while still listening. The listening is what makes the respect true.

line:
Across generations, envy of the young is fear of being finished. Admiration of the young is how an elder stays in the story without owning it.

line:
An elder who has been afraid and stayed is a better teacher than an elder who claims never to have shaken. The shaking, survived, is the lesson.

practice: Stay until the scared person is breathing slowly. Do not explain the dark away before you have sat in it.

z: 奙 i-pancreas, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
An elder who gives the best piece away is not being careless with the future. The elder is showing the future how a house continues.

practice: Pass the best portion first. The first piece teaches the house what it is.

z: 奜 i-pancreas, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
An elder's stories are a kind of speech that builds or bends a family. Tell the story in which people are repaired. The other story will tell itself.

line:
An elder who still notices the small faithfulness in the house is a gift to the young. The young become what is noticed.

This is the work of a house after a loss. The member drawn is i-pancreas, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu. Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 奞 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: Thank a person for a labor you have stopped seeing. Thank the labor, not their temperament.

z: 奡 i-pancreas, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
An elder's quiet can be a shelter or a locked door. The young can tell which, by whether they are welcome to come and say nothing beside you.

line:
Some breaks end a household. That too can be told with dignity. Forgiveness then is the refusal to poison the years that follow. The children still have to live in them.

line:
An elder who speaks of the dead by name, without recruiting the young into despair, gives the family its memory and its future in the same breath.

line:
An elder who has looked again, many mornings, is a quiet argument against the lie. Do not turn the elder into a slogan. Let the morning itself be seen.

An elder who lays down a feud gives the young a future that is not already written. That is one of the last great gifts a generation can give the next.

line:
Envy is love of a good thing, twisted until the good thing must shrink. The love was real. That is why it hurts. Turned, the same look becomes admiration, which is fed by another person's light.

line:
Fear is the mind counting what it loves and what it could lose. That count is not a defect. It is proof of attachment, and attachment is how a family exists. Courage is fear that stays in the room.

z: 她 i-pancreas, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla
line:
Greed is the fear that there will not be enough, wearing the mask of appetite. Bread kept in a closed hand goes stale. Generosity is the same hand remembering the table.

z: 奺 i-pancreas, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
The tongue is the smallest member and the widest fire. Every tradition that lasted put a guard on it, because a family is made of sentences more than of walls.

line:
Contempt is a shortcut. It saves a person from having to look. Inside it is the power it refuses: the power to see a thing clearly. Clear sight is the beginning of thanks.

line:
There is a silence that punishes and a silence that accompanies. They use the same closed mouth. The difference is whether the person has left while remaining in the chair.

line:
Betrayal proves that trust was real, because only a real bond breaks with that sound. Forgiveness is not the pretence that the bowl never cracked. It is gold in the crack, and the decision to eat from that bowl again, slowly.

line:
Grief is love with nowhere to go. It feels like an evil because it stops the house. It is not an invader. It is a force large enough to be mistaken for one. Compassion is that force sitting down beside someone else.

line:
Despair says the dawn is a lie because the room is dark. The force inside it is the fact that someone is still at the window. Waiting is already a kind of faithfulness, even when it feels like defeat.

line:
Revenge believes that pain can be balanced by being copied. It cannot. The copy multiplies, and the family becomes a ledger. Mercy is the refusal to become the injury.

line:
A marriage can survive a true no. It cannot survive a no that was only a wound looking for a second body. Protection is the no that guards the bond, not the no that wins the evening.

A parent who comes down to a child's height does not lose rank. Rank was the costume. The person remains. Dignity is the choice to be seen without requiring worship.

line:
A family that can clap for its own is already rich. The eye is the first thief, and it can be the first blessing. The difference is whether the good is allowed to remain in the other hand.

line:

practice: Name the person you are afraid of losing, and spend the next hour near them without a speech.

z: 妎 ubende, phezulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
Generosity is not the opposite of need. It is need that has remembered other mouths. The first portion, not the remainder, teaches the house what it is.

practice: Give a thing away that you still like. Do not wait until you are tired of it.

z: 妏 ubende, phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Healing speech is not sweetness. Sweetness can be a lie. Healing speech is accuracy with mercy. It names the hurt and refuses the insult that wanted to ride along.

line:
What is despised at home is despised twice, because home was the place it should have been safe to be plain. Appreciation is looking that did not turn away.

This is the work of a house after a loss. ubende, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu is the place this turning becomes visible. 妐 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Ask to be shown a skill you had decided was beneath you. Watch the whole way through.

z: 妑 ubende, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Cold silence is absence wearing a body. Presence is that silence warmed by staying. Put the object down. Let the eyes finish the sentence the mouth is not ready to speak.

This is the work of a house after a loss. ubende, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele is the place this turning becomes visible. 妑 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Put the glowing thing in another room. Sit where you can be seen. You do not have to perform a talk.

z: 妔 ubende, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla
line:
A family that cannot mend becomes a set of strangers who still share a key. Mercy here is not amnesia. It is the refusal to make the break the only story the children inherit.

This is the work of a house after a loss. ubende, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla is the place this turning becomes visible. 妔 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Name the break once, without extra charges. Then do one small trustworthy thing, and repeat it tomorrow.

z: 妕 ubende, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
The empty chair is not decorated away. The shawl is the theology. Every house that lasted taught its people to weep with those who weep, and only then to speak.

This is the work of a house after a loss. ubende, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu is the place this turning becomes visible. 妕 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Do not hurry a grieving person into cheer. Let the absent name be said.

z: 妗 ubende, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Hope, in the old sense, is not a mood and not a forecast. It is the small fidelity of looking again. Families are made of that looking: one more morning, one more place set.

This is the work of a house after a loss. ubende, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu is the place this turning becomes visible. 妗 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Open the curtain before you decide what the day is. Let the house see you do it.
